passage: Where the word hip-hop came from is something no one can prove.
Still, the story most often told places its first use at a block party.
A young man there was days away from reporting to the army.
His close friend, who was running the party as MC, decided to tease him about it.
Marching across the stage to the beat like a drill instructor, he chanted the syllables hip-hop again and again.
The crowd was delighted, and other MCs soon built their own playful lines out of the same sounds.
Those lines hardened into a regular feature of rap and reached the lyrics of the first recorded hip-hop album.
With that record, the music, the dancing, and the name itself travelled far beyond the Bronx.
choices: how a playful party chant turned into the name of a culture
the strict training methods used by American military instructors
the recording techniques behind the first hip-hop album of 1979
the difficulty of tracing the origins of English slang words
the reasons young men in the Bronx chose to join the army
